text.arabic_uthmani: مَا جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَحِيرَةٍۢ وَلَا سَآئِبَةٍۢ وَلَا وَصِيلَةٍۢ وَلَا حَامٍۢ ۙ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ ۖ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ

words.gloss_range: opening negation over a completed making act; it launches a categorical denial rather than narration or command
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) opens the ayah as categorical denial. It negates a completed act of institution and lets that denial govern the whole animal inventory, so the reader begins with divine non-authorization rather than folklore description.

topics.headline: categorical opening denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees from the first word that the ayah is denying any divine institution of the entire animal-category system.
topics.reason: The opening particle negates the completed making verb and its scope extends through the four listed categories.

topics.headline: chosen negation with sound-thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening denial as the first element in a repeated negation pattern, while the local function remains plain negation.
topics.reason: The particle can carry other functions elsewhere, but local grammar selects negation; the sound-thread survives as structural payoff.

words.gloss_range: negated institutional making or designation for the four named categories; not biological creation of the animals
words.root_gloss_range: making, appointing, rendering, and instituting; the local frame selects legal designation rather than biological creation
words.prose: {{ar:جَعَلَ}} ({{tr:jaʿala}}) names the denied act as making or designation. In this setting the verb is narrowed to legal institution: God did not assign sacred status to the four categories, and one negated verb governs all four exclusions. That negated making contrasts with authorized divine making at 5:97 and unauthorized lawful-unlawful claims at 10:59, while the 48:26 heat-protection echo remains a limited background contrast rather than the local sense.

topics.headline: institutional making under negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial targets divine authorization of statuses, not the existence of the animals themselves.
topics.reason: The local objects are named legal-status categories, so broad making or creation pressure is narrowed to institution and designation.

topics.headline: one verb governs four exclusions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps all four animal names under one denied divine act instead of treating later items as separate claims.
topics.reason: The syntax carries the same negated verb through the coordinated list.

topics.headline: authorized making contrasts fabricated status
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare this negated making with places where divine making authorizes a real sacred order, especially 5:97 and 10:59.
topics.reason: The concrete parallels keep the legal-designation field visible without changing the local negated sense.

topics.headline: root-near echo to protected-status language
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a limited echo between denied making here and heat-protection language elsewhere, while the local verb still means institution.
topics.reason: The 48:26 echo is useful as a contrast, but it does not alter the local sense of the making verb.

words.gloss_range: explicit divine subject of the negated act, making God the named non-source of the categories
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field of worship and ultimate authority; local use concerns source authority for institution
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) is the explicit subject of the negated verb. The ayah names God as the non-source of the invented categories, and that same divine authority will return later as the target of the false attribution.

topics.headline: named divine non-source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that God is not merely absent from the practice; He is named as the one who did not institute it.
topics.reason: The proper divine name is nominative subject of the negated verb.

topics.headline: worship-authority derivation controls
topics.reader_payoff: The reader retains the divine-authority pressure of the name while avoiding a derivational overreading unrelated to the local legal claim.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute is preserved only where it serves the authority question; local syntax concerns the source of law.

topics.headline: first divine name anticipates later target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the name first denies divine agency and later returns as the target of false attribution.
topics.reason: The repeated divine name frames the ayah from non-institution to accusation.

words.gloss_range: partitive-reinforcing preposition after negation, giving the list no-instance force while governing the first noun and the inherited series
words.prose: {{ar:مِنۢ}} ({{tr:min}}) gives the denial no-instance force. It keeps the first animal name grammatically governed while its force carries through the inherited list, turning the catalogue into a single excluded field. At the list opening, the tight sound and grammar make the first object attach to the negating frame, and the prior warning becomes a concrete named catalogue.

topics.headline: no-instance prepositional force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the denial excludes even a single valid instance of the claimed category field.
topics.reason: The preposition after negation reinforces the no-instance scope while governing the list field.

topics.headline: grammar heard at the list opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first object attach tightly to the negating frame and sees the prior warning become a named catalogue.
topics.reason: The sound note and boundary bridge both reinforce the opening of the governed inventory.

words.gloss_range: indefinite slit-marked livestock category denied any divine status under the list grammar
words.root_gloss_range: sea, vastness, splitting, and slit-marking branches; the local noun selects the specialized slit-marked animal label
words.prose: {{ar:بَحِيرَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:baḥīratin}}) is the first concrete label in that field. The word points to a marked animal category, yet the indefinite form under negation denies every specimen any divine status; the same root's sea-field contrast at 5:96 sharpens the difference between permitted provision and invented taboo. Its rare form gains no positive scriptural life here: the label appears as a unique, negated status-name.

topics.headline: any specimen of the first label denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first animal term as a whole class denied divine status, not a single known animal.
topics.reason: Indefiniteness under the reinforced negation gives the noun class-wide no-instance force.

topics.headline: physical mark becomes status label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a slit or mark has been turned into a sacred-status label, while the broad sea branch does not become the local sense.
topics.reason: The local animal inventory selects the specialized slit-marked label; wider sea and vastness pressure survives only as narrowed image background.

topics.headline: first item opens fabricated inventory
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the word as the first mechanism in a four-part fabricated status system, with a same-surah contrast to permitted sea provision (5:96).
topics.reason: The four labels form one inventory, and the 5:96 contrast is concrete enough to preserve as a same-root contrast.

topics.headline: unique form appears to be negated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this rare form gains no positive scriptural life; its sole role here is to be refused divine standing.
topics.reason: The distributional rows make rarity part of the lexical payoff without changing the local sense.

words.gloss_range: coordinator that adds the second list item under the same negated making frame
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) starts the first added step in the animal list. It coordinates another item under the original denial, so the second category is added without a new predicate or a new legal claim.

topics.headline: second item added under same denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the list begin to accumulate while the original negated making frame remains in force.
topics.reason: The coordinator plus following negator adds a second object without restarting the clause.

words.gloss_range: repeated list negator that renews inherited negation for the second item
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) renews the inherited negation for the second animal name. The repeated particle gives that label its own denied slot and begins the audible refrain that will run through the list.

topics.headline: first repeated negator marks a distinct slot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the second animal label receive its own negation marker rather than collapsing into the first.
topics.reason: The repeated negator renews the inherited denial locally and contributes to the ayah-wide negation thread.

words.gloss_range: indefinite released-roaming livestock category denied any divine authorization
words.root_gloss_range: flowing, release, letting loose, and gift imagery; the local noun selects the released-animal status label
words.prose: {{ar:سَآئِبَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:sāʾibatin}}) brings in a released or roaming animal label. Its root pressure makes the false freedom visible: a human-imposed release-status is named as if it naturally flows free, then placed under the same denial of divine authorization. The internally marked form and isolated occurrence keep the supposedly free-flowing label visibly constructed inside the negated list.

topics.headline: released category inside same no-instance frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the released-animal label governed by the same no-instance denial as the first term.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite, genitive by inherited governance, and still a logical object of the negated making frame.

topics.headline: released flow becomes fabricated status
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that a label of release and flow names a human-imposed status that is denied divine authority.
topics.reason: The local noun selects the released-roaming animal status; broader flow and gift imagery survives as image pressure rather than a separate sense.

topics.headline: marked hapax in the denied list
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the supposedly free-flowing category is itself formally marked and distributionally isolated in a negated occurrence.
topics.reason: The hamza and hapax rows add a distinct form-and-distribution payoff.

words.gloss_range: coordinator that adds the third list item without restarting the predicate
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds the third item with the same cumulative force. The coordinator lets the inventory grow while keeping the legal predicate fixed.

topics.headline: third item added without new predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the inventory grow cumulatively while the legal predicate remains unchanged.
topics.reason: The coordinator adds the connection-category to the same governed object field.

words.gloss_range: repeated list negator that gives the third item its own excluded slot
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) marks the third animal label as separately excluded. It renews negation locally without turning the list into separate sentences.

topics.headline: middle negator preserves item-by-item exclusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the third category get a separate denied slot inside one continuous clause.
topics.reason: The repeated negator renews the governing denial without creating a new sentence.

words.gloss_range: indefinite connection-derived livestock category denied divine institution
words.root_gloss_range: joining, reaching, connection, and maintained bonds; the local noun selects a connection-derived animal status
words.prose: {{ar:وَصِيلَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:waṣīlatin}}) turns connection into a denied status category. The word preserves the payoff that a relationship or birth-link has been made to transfer sacred privilege, while echoes of true commanded joining in 2:27 and 13:21 remain contrast rather than the local sense. Its concrete noun form is distributionally marked, so the connection label appears as a denied fabricated category rather than an endorsed bond.

topics.headline: connection label denied as a class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a relation-based label turned into a countable category and denied divine institution.
topics.reason: The indefinite noun under inherited governance names a whole connection-derived class, not a single example.

topics.headline: relationship becomes false privilege
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that mere connection or birth relation is being made to transfer sacred status, which the ayah refuses.
topics.reason: The local sense is the connection-derived animal category; wider joining and approach branches survive only as narrowed pressure.

topics.headline: fabricated connection contrasts commanded joining
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can contrast this false animal connection with commanded joining in 2:27 and 13:21.
topics.reason: The references give concrete root-field contrasts that do not override the local animal-label sense.

topics.headline: unique concrete connection noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this concrete form is distributionally marked, appearing as a denied fabricated label rather than an endorsed bond.
topics.reason: The uniqueness rows supply a real distributional payoff.

words.gloss_range: final list coordinator that introduces the terminal animal category before the adversative turn
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) introduces the terminal item of the inventory. Its position prepares the list to close before the ayah pivots to the human source of the fabrication.

topics.headline: final addition before the pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the enumeration preparing to close before the ayah turns to blame.
topics.reason: The coordinator adds the terminal animal while preserving the same negated predicate.

words.gloss_range: final list negator sealing the fourfold exclusion before the adversative turn
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) seals the fourfold animal denial. The last list-negator gives the final category its own exclusion and anticipates the closing denial of reasoning.

topics.headline: last repeated negator seals the inventory
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the fourth category receive its own denial and hears that denial anticipate the final cognitive negation.
topics.reason: The repeated negator closes the animal-list exclusion before the adversative clause.

words.gloss_range: indefinite protected-stallion category, terminal in the denied animal inventory
words.root_gloss_range: protection, guardedness, heat, and zeal; the local noun selects the protected-stallion status while heat and zeal remain echo pressure
words.prose: {{ar:حَامٍۢ}} ({{tr:ḥāmin}}) closes the list with a protected-stallion label after three feminine categories. As an indefinite terminal class, it denies any protected-stallion instance divine standing, and the word makes claimed immunity or guardedness the final fabricated mechanism. Heat and zeal echoes such as 48:26 remain limited background pressure, while the isolated concrete form keeps this animal label distributionally marked.

topics.headline: final protected-stallion class denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final masculine stallion label as another whole class denied divine standing, not an exception at the end.
topics.reason: The terminal noun is indefinite, governed by the inherited prepositional frame, and functions as the last object of the negated making.

topics.headline: guarded status loses divine backing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a protection or immunity claim is being personified in the animal label, then stripped of divine authorization.
topics.reason: The local noun selects the protected-stallion category; heat and zeal remain narrowed image pressure rather than the selected sense.

topics.headline: limited heat-zeal contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear a limited contrast with heated partisan zeal in 48:26 while keeping the local word on protected-stallion status.
topics.reason: The 48:26 root echo is concrete but does not govern the local parse.

topics.headline: isolated concrete animal form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this concrete protection label appears as an isolated denied category.
topics.reason: The distributional rows add a distinct rarity payoff.

words.gloss_range: resumptive coordinator at the discourse pivot, shifting from list denial to accusation
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) no longer works like the list coordinators. Attached to the adversative particle, it marks the compact turn from denied divine institution to the charge against those producing the lie.

topics.headline: same coordinator becomes discourse turn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah turn from what God did not institute to who is actually producing the false attribution.
topics.reason: The coordinator attached to the adversative particle marks a boundary rather than another list item.

words.gloss_range: heavy adversative particle governing the correction clause and assigning human source after divine non-institution
words.prose: {{ar:لَٰكِنَّ}} ({{tr:lākinna}}) is the ayah's heavy hinge. It governs the corrective clause and changes the movement from legal denial to forensic accusation: the categories are not neutral customs but fabricated attribution. The same adversative-indictment pattern appears in corrective turns such as 5:81 and 6:33, which keeps the pivot formal rather than conversational.

topics.headline: governed corrective clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the correction is grammatically weighty: the particle governs a full accusation clause.
topics.reason: The particle governs the relative subject and verbal predicate, so the turn is syntactically consequential.

topics.headline: central structural hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah move in three beats: divine non-institution, human fabrication, and failed reasoning.
topics.reason: The adversative position prevents the denied categories from seeming neutral and assigns their source to fabrication.

topics.headline: known indictment pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the particle as part of a Quranic corrective-indictment pattern, including 5:81 and 6:33.
topics.reason: The concrete parallels support the adversative indictment role without adding a new local sense.

words.gloss_range: definite relative pronoun that forms the governed subject bloc and identifies the group through the following action
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) builds the subject bloc for that accusation. The group is not named by tribe; it is defined through the following disbelief action before the predicate of fabrication arrives.

topics.headline: group defined by following action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the fabricating group defined by its disbelief before the ongoing fabrication is named.
topics.reason: The definite relative pronoun fills the governed subject slot and depends on the following clause for identity.

words.gloss_range: perfect plural disbelief verb, presenting truth-covering as an established group state before the ongoing fabrication
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealing, denial, disbelief, and ingratitude; local use marks an established truth-covering state
words.prose: {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:kafarū}}) presents disbelief as an established collective state. The covering image fits the ayah's logic: divine non-institution is covered over by status labels, and from that settled state ongoing fabrication proceeds. Same-surah rejection patterns and the heat-zeal cluster at 48:26 keep this diagnosis tied to a wider field of truth-covering and partisan status-making.

topics.headline: established truth-covering before fabrication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ongoing fabrication grows out of an already established state of covering or denial.
topics.reason: The perfect plural form marks a completed group state before the imperfect fabrication verb.

topics.headline: diagnostic label in wider patterns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can connect this diagnostic label with same-surah rejection patterns and the heat-zeal cluster at 48:26.
topics.reason: The concrete cross-references support a pattern of diagnosis without changing the local completed-state reading.

words.gloss_range: imperfect Form VIII fabrication verb, naming ongoing forged attribution with target and lie-object
words.root_gloss_range: fabrication, splitting-off, and counterfeit origination pressure; local Form VIII selects ongoing forged attribution
words.prose: {{ar:يَفْتَرُونَ}} ({{tr:yaftarūna}}) names the actual human production. Its imperfect form makes the forgery habitual, and its argument frame points both to the divine target and to the specific lie being manufactured. The root pressure makes the forgery feel like counterfeit origination while Form VIII keeps the local sense on fabrication, and the exact false-attribution formula recurs at 4:50.

topics.headline: habitual forgery with target and object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the false system as ongoing production of a lie directed against God, not a one-time misunderstanding.
topics.reason: The imperfect verb governs both the target phrase and the produced lie-object.

topics.headline: fabrication as counterfeit production
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices fabrication as a self-generated counterfeit of origination, while the local Form VIII sense remains forgery rather than creation.
topics.reason: Root-family origination and cleaving pressure is kept as image pressure, but local morphology selects fabrication.

topics.headline: recognized accusation formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the clause as a formal Quranic charge of forging falsehood against God, with an exact parallel at 4:50.
topics.reason: The formula and root-pair rows give a concrete provenance for the accusation frame.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking adversarial target; the lie is placed upon or against God
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) turns fabrication into directed imposition. The preposition keeps its upon-against pressure, so the lie is not merely spoken about God but placed against the divine name.

topics.headline: falsehood placed against God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the preposition turn fabrication into an imposed attribution against God, not merely speech about God.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the divine name as target and is part of the fixed false-attribution formula.

words.gloss_range: repeated divine name as genitive target of fabrication, reversing the earlier subject role
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field of worship and ultimate authority; local use marks the divine name as target of false attribution
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) repeats the divine name in a new role. God was first the subject who did not institute the categories; here the same authority is the target on whom the lie is imposed.

topics.headline: non-agent becomes target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same divine name shift from subject of denied making to target on whom the lie is imposed.
topics.reason: The genitive role under the target preposition visibly reverses the nominative role earlier in the ayah.

topics.headline: authority invoked falsely
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the authority denied as maker is the very authority misused by the fabricated claim.
topics.reason: The divine-name derivation issue remains narrowed to worship and authority; the local grammar makes God the target of false attribution.

words.gloss_range: definite accusative falsehood, the specific lie produced by fabrication and imposed against God
words.root_gloss_range: lying, denial, rejection, and false speech; local use names the specific falsehood produced by fabrication
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكَذِبَ}} ({{tr:al-kadhiba}}) names the fabricated product. Its definiteness gathers the several animal-status claims into the specific lie, and the formula has a concrete parallel in the false-attribution charge at 4:50.

topics.headline: the specific lie as object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the four customs gathered into one specific falsehood produced by fabrication.
topics.reason: The definite accusative verbal noun completes the fabrication valency as the produced object.

topics.headline: formal false-attribution charge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears not a disputed custom but a formal charge: the named content is falsehood attributed against God, with formulaic parallels such as 4:50.
topics.reason: The falsehood noun, fabrication pairing, and concrete formula parallels preserve the moral-epistemic verdict.

words.gloss_range: coordinator adding the final cognitive diagnosis to the fabrication charge
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) attaches a second diagnosis after the fabrication charge. The final clause is connected to what came before, but it also opens a distinct cognitive verdict about the broader majority.

topics.headline: fabrication charge followed by cognition verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final clause as a second diagnosis attached to the fabrication charge, while not turning every individual into the same kind of active fabricator.
topics.reason: The coordinator adds a distinct cognitive verdict; claims about differentiating fabricators and followers are kept as a structural implication, not an absolute social taxonomy.

words.gloss_range: comparative-superlative majority term with attached pronoun, quantifying most of the same group without totalizing it
words.root_gloss_range: manyness, increase, abundance, and greater-part selection; local form quantifies the group as most, not all
words.prose: {{ar:أَكْثَرُهُمْ}} ({{tr:aktharuhum}}) quantifies that verdict as a standing nominal diagnosis. The form says most of the same group, not all, so the ayah can condemn mass unreason while still leaving room for a narrower circle of deliberate fabricators. The closing majority-failure formula has concrete parallels at 2:100, 25:44, 29:63, and 5:64.

topics.headline: nominal majority verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees majority unreason as a standing diagnosis attached to the same group, not a passing event.
topics.reason: The nominative majority term begins a nominal clause and its pronoun points back to the identified group.

topics.headline: partitive majority avoids totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the indictment is broad but not universal, leaving room to distinguish deliberate inventors from a wider unreasoning majority.
topics.reason: The comparative-superlative form and attached pronoun quantify the greater part without totalizing the group.

topics.headline: known majority-failure formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the closing phrase as part of a wider majority-failure formula, including 2:100, 25:44, 29:63, and the same-surah pattern at 5:64.
topics.reason: The concrete formula rows support the generalizing tail without overriding the local reasoning failure.

words.gloss_range: negator before an imperfect cognition verb, making the final failure ongoing and visible
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) makes the final negation visible before the cognition verb. It answers the opening denial by shifting from no divine institution to no ongoing reasoning among the majority.

topics.headline: visible negator before ongoing reasoning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final failure as continuing lack of reasoning, not one missed inference.
topics.reason: The independent negator before an imperfect verb gives the cognition verdict ongoing force.

topics.headline: opening denial answered by final denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the denial move from false categories to failed reasoning, binding the beginning and end of the ayah.
topics.reason: The final negator echoes the list negators and answers the opening denial structurally and acoustically.

words.gloss_range: imperfect plural reasoning verb under negation, closing the ayah with collective failure to bind judgment
words.root_gloss_range: binding, tethering, restraint, and reasoning; local use selects ongoing exercise of reason as binding judgment
words.prose: {{ar:يَعْقِلُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿqilūna}}) is the final landing point. The ayah closes not on the animal names or even on the lie, but on failed reasoning: after fabricated livestock restrictions, the missing tether is judgment itself. Because no explicit object is named, the failure is not confined to one claim; a comprehension-oriented variant and parallels at 5:58 and 10:100 confirm that the closing issue is cognitive while the canonical wording keeps the binding-reasoning image in front.

topics.headline: final collective reasoning failure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader lands on failed reasoning as the ayah's final answer to denied institution and ongoing fabrication.
topics.reason: The imperfect plural verb under negation agrees with the quantified majority and closes the ayah.

topics.headline: reasoning failure not limited to one object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that no explicit object limits the failure, so the verdict covers their whole failure to bind the evidence into judgment.
topics.reason: The verb appears without an explicit object, broadening the cognitive verdict beyond one named claim.

topics.headline: missing tether after livestock taboos
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the closing irony: after fabricated livestock restrictions, the missing faculty is the binding or tethering of judgment itself.
topics.reason: The root's binding and tethering image survives as local payoff because the ayah concerns livestock taboos, while the selected sense remains reasoning.

topics.headline: cognition pressure confirmed by variant and parallels
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the closing issue is cognitive, whether framed as binding reason or comprehension, with same-surah recurrence at 5:58 and a making-reasoning link at 10:100.
topics.reason: The variant clarifies the cognitive pressure point but does not replace the canonical reasoning root.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated divine making governs four coordinated livestock status-names, each anchored in a physical or social operation on an animal.
baseline_models.mechanism: A slit marker, release from ordinary control, a kin-link that changes treatment, and a protected breeding male form a human classification that reallocates animal use. The negated making blocks those operations from becoming divinely constituted statuses.

activation_trace.role: State-conferral is the precise making force denied to the four categories.
The wide slit supplies a visible body mark used to assign the first status.
The released animal supplies a status defined by withdrawal from ordinary benefit or allegiance.
A sibling connection supplies a genealogical rule that redirects the male animal's treatment.
The protected breeding camel supplies a use-exemption imposed after reproductive service.

changed_reading.before: God did not create four special kinds of livestock.
changed_reading.after: God did not confer sacred or legal force on a human livestock taxonomy encoded by marks, release, kin linkage, and protected use.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The accusation of fabrication follows names whose branch images include cutting and joining.
baseline_models.mechanism: The cutting-and-stitching image within fabrication meets the slit and connection already built into the animal names. The lie can therefore be read as an actively assembled norm: material signs and relational labels are fitted together and then attributed to God.

activation_trace.role: A cut in the animal supplies one material component of the constructed classification.
Joining one thing to another supplies the assembly operation linking signs, animals, and rulings.
Cutting for repair and stitching supplies the constructive, fitted-together side of fabrication.
Invented falsehood supplies the explicit attributional offense produced by that assembly.
Naming or saying supplies the step by which constructed statuses are presented as an authoritative classification.

changed_reading.before: They state a false proposition about God's rule.
changed_reading.after: They assemble a norm out of cuts, linkages, and names, then present that fitted taxonomy as God's own institution.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The closing majority clause couples numerical predominance with failure of reason.
baseline_models.mechanism: Numerical multiplication can make a convention socially dominant, while reason should restrain ignorance and test its warrant. The focus therefore withholds evidentiary force from the convention's prevalence.

activation_trace.role: Dominance by number supplies the social pressure carried by the majority.
Reason as restraint from ignorance supplies the missing check on repeated custom.
Contradiction of truth identifies what numerical dominance fails to convert into warrant.

changed_reading.before: Most adherents simply fail to understand.
changed_reading.after: The convention's majority support is itself an epistemic pressure that reason should restrain, not evidence that can authorize the rule.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening prohibition against prohibiting what God has released from restriction turns the four statuses into practical encroachments, not merely mistaken vocabulary. Human restriction crosses a boundary when it reverses divine permission.

activation_trace.role: The denied state-conferral anchors the delta in the livestock categories' claimed normative status.
Human prohibition supplies the restrictive act that the animal statuses can perform in practice.
Dissolution of a ban supplies the divine permission that fabricated restrictions reverse.
Crossing a limit supplies the legal direction of the reversal from permission into taboo.

structural_cues: 5:87 forbids people to prohibit what God made lawful, while 5:103 denies that God made the four restrictive statuses.
Both constructions oppose a human norm to an explicit divine act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine permission, human prohibition, and a boundary violation; I infer that the four statuses restrict ordinary animal use. A live alternative is that their primary fault is false attribution even where a particular status does not prohibit consumption.

changed_reading.before: The four labels are an inaccurate taxonomy.
changed_reading.after: The labels are unauthorized taboo-making that reverses divine permission and thereby crosses a normative boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: The oath passage distinguishes discarded speech from a deliberately knotted obligation, preserves that obligation, and gives breach a repair path. Against that sequence, the livestock regime looks like a pseudo-bond: inherited labels constrain use without a declared covenant or accountable release.

activation_trace.role: Binding a camel supplies the concrete animal-domain image for an obligation that restrains conduct.
Speech thrown aside as non-counting supplies the sequence's negative case for obligation.
Binding and ratifying a covenant supplies the positive act that makes an obligation legible.
Covering a breach through expiation supplies an explicit repair mechanism for a valid bond.
The sworn oath supplies the accountable speech act behind the bond.
Guarding a covenant supplies continuing custody of an obligation after it is made.

structural_cues: 5:89 moves from non-counting speech to contracted oaths, expiation, and preservation.
5:103 closes an animal-status list with a root whose inventory also includes binding a camel.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies valid verbal bonds and animal binding; I infer that the customary labels operate as unaccountable social bonds. They may instead concern categorical attribution without functioning like oaths.

changed_reading.after: The custom is a counterfeit obligation: it binds animal use without the declared commitment, custody, and repair that make a real obligation accountable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hunt and sanctuary sequence supplies a positive comparator for sacred animal regulation: adjudicated equivalence, an offering directed to the sanctuary, a public stabilizing institution, and a visible garland. The four false statuses mimic parts of this sign system but lack its disclosed authorization and public procedure.

activation_trace.role: The denied conferral of status anchors the comparison with a nearby affirmative divine institution.
Judgment between people supplies an accountable procedure for fixing an animal-related obligation.
Equivalence supplies the measurable relation between the hunted animal and its compensation.
The offering sent to the sanctuary supplies a genuinely authorized sacred-animal status.
Affirmative divine state-conferral supplies the direct grammatical counterweight to the focus denial.
Social maintenance and support supply the public function of a legitimate institution.
A neck-marker supplies a visible sign whose authority comes from the disclosed institution, not the mark alone.

structural_cues: 5:97 affirmatively states that God made named sanctuary institutions; 5:103 uses the same subject and verb under negation.
5:95-97 and 5:103 share the animal, sacred-status, and visible-marker domain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored divine-making clauses and nearby regulated animals; I infer that the affirmative institution furnishes a legitimacy test for the denied statuses. The passages could also be adjacent examples without every positive feature serving as a formal criterion.

changed_reading.before: God rejects four isolated pre-Islamic animal customs.
changed_reading.after: God rejects counterfeit sacred statuses by contrast with animal regulations that have disclosed institution, public function, adjudication, destination, and authorized signs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicit warning that abundant badness can impress without becoming equal to goodness explains how a majority sustains the fabricated statuses. Repetition creates visual and social plausibility, but not equivalence or truth.

activation_trace.role: Numerical dominance supplies the majority pressure whose warrant the focus rejects.
Cognitive restraint supplies the faculty needed to resist numerical plausibility.
Denied equivalence supplies the logical rule that quantity cannot level unlike values.
Badness opposed to goodness supplies the value distinction that abundance cannot erase.
Goodness opposed to badness supplies the stable comparator despite unequal quantities.
What looks good to the eye supplies the seduction exerted by a widespread convention.
Growing quantity supplies the explicit abundance that can impress without validating.

structural_cues: 5:100 places abundance, attraction, and people of understanding in one warning.
5:103 closes with the paired ideas of the majority and failure to reason.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared abundance vocabulary and adjacent cognitive appeals; I infer that prevalence is a mechanism of customary credibility. The majority clause could remain a general moral diagnosis rather than a claim about how the custom spread.

changed_reading.before: Most people happen not to understand the ruling.
changed_reading.after: The custom survives because numerical abundance itself impresses; the closing clause rejects majoritarian prevalence as a substitute for discriminating reason.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reply that inherited precedent is sufficient identifies the transmission system behind the majority. The animal statuses reproduce because finding fathers upon a practice is treated as self-authenticating, even without knowledge or guidance.

activation_trace.role: Reason as a restraint on ignorance anchors the focus diagnosis in the inherited practice.
Claimed sufficiency supplies the closure that prevents inherited precedent from being tested.
Finding an already existing practice supplies passive reception rather than demonstrated authorization.
Fathers and upbringing supply the intergenerational carrier of the status system.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hem kullanım dışı bırakılan adak hayvanını hem de özel bir özgürleştirme işlemiyle statüsü değişen köleleştirilmiş kişiyi destekler. Bununla birlikte bağlılık hakkının eski sahibinde kalıp kalmadığı konusunda aktarımlar karşıt hükümler verdiğinden insanla ilgili alt anlam tek bir kesin sonuca indirgenemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak biçimin iki tarihsel statüsünü kapsar; genel bırakma eylemini veya her türlü özgürleşmeyi bu dala taşımaz.

concept_map.definition: Tarihsel kullanımda, adak veya dönem geleneği nedeniyle binilmeyen, çalıştırılmayan ve suyla otlaktan çevrilmeyen deveyi; ayrıca özgürleştirilmesiyle malı ve eski sahibiyle bağı özel kurallara bağlanan köleleştirilmiş kişiyi adlandırır. İnsanla ilgili kullanımda bağlılık hakkının eski sahibinde kalıp kalmadığı konusunda kaynaklar ayrılır.

facets.statement: Bir deve adak veya dönem geleneği gereği serbest bırakılır; sırtından yararlanılmaz ve suyla otlaktan uzaklaştırılmaz.
Köleleştirilmiş kişi özgürleştirilir ve malını kullanmasıyla eski sahibine bağlılık hakkı özel hükme bağlanır.
Aktarımlar, özgürleştirilen kişinin bağlılık hakkının eski sahibinde kalması veya kalmaması konusunda uyuşmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başka bir şeye ekleyerek ona bağlı duruma getirmek ya da iki veya daha çok şeyin birbirinden kopuk olmayacak biçimde birleşmiş bulunmasıdır. Bağlı şeyler arasındaki ilişki veya aracı bağ da bu kapsamda adlandırılabilir.

facets.statement: Bir şey başka bir şeye eklenir ve ona bağlı duruma getirilir.

Giysi ya da ayakkabı parçalarını birbirine eklemek ve ipte ekleme aracı kullanmak bu çekirdeğin belirli uygulamalarıdır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أصل الوصل والاتصال في الأعيان والمعاني، ووصل الشيء بالشيء، واتحاد بعض الأشياء ببعض، وما بين المتصلين من وصلة.

يدخل فيه اتصال الرجل بقوم، والانتساب أو الاعتزاء إليهم، والدعاء بدعوى الجاهلية نحو يا لفلان، وما فسر به يصلون إلى قوم.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, bir kişiyi ya da şeyi tehlikeden savmayı temel alır ve buradan korunan otlak, yaklaşılması yasak şey, hastayı zararlı yiyecekten uzak tutma, insanların bir şeyden sakınması ve savaşta yakınları koruma kullanımlarına açılır. Verilen koruma ve önleme çerçevesi bu yapıyı doğru kurar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel koruma çekirdeği korunur; otlak, hasta, yiyecek ve kaçınma yapılarının özel kapsamı yalın koruma anlamına katılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiye, topluluğa, yere ya da şeye yönelebilecek zararı veya yaklaşmayı savmak ve onu erişimden uzak tutmaktır. Korunan otlak, hastaya zararlı yiyeceği yasaklama ve insanların tehlikeli gördükleri şeyden kaçınması bu çekirdeğin özel düzenlemeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da şey zarar, saldırı veya istenmeyen yaklaşmaya karşı korunur.
Bir otlak ya da yer başkalarının yaklaşmasına ve yararlanmasına kapatılır.
Hasta, kendisine zarar verecek yiyeceklerden uzak tutulur ya da bunlardan kendisi sakınır.
İnsanlar sakıncalı gördükleri bir şeyden uzak durur ve ona yaklaşmaz.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bir şeye yönelen zararı veya yaklaşmayı savma çekirdeğini ortaklaşa verir. Bu çekirdek savaşta yakınları savunmaya, erişimi kapatılmış yere, hastayı zararlı yiyecekten uzak tutmaya ve insanların bir şeyden sakınmasına uygulanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Zararı savma ile bir kişi ya da şeyi istenmeyen erişimden uzak tutma yönlerini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Savma, koruma ve yaklaşmayı önleme çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin yiyecekten ya da tehlikeli gördüğü bir şeyden kendi isteğiyle uzak durduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Zarara karşı uzak durma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Başkasını savunma ve bir alanı erişime kapatma yönlerini vermez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, uzun süre damızlıkta kalan ya da belirli sayıda döl veren erkek devenin sırtının dokunulmaz sayılmasını; ona binilmemesini, yününün kırkılmamasını ve otlaktan alıkonmamasını anlatır. Verilen çerçeve doğrudur, ancak bu ayrıcalık her erkek deveye değil, kaynaklarda farklı biçimde belirtilen damızlık koşulunu karşılayan hayvana aittir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın hayvan adını kendi eski uygulama sınırında tutar ve genel koruma ya da serbest otlatma anlamlarını dala katmaz.

concept_map.definition: Damızlıkta uzun süre kullanıldığı ya da belirli bir döl verme ölçüsüne ulaştığı için sırtı dokunulmaz sayılan erkek devedir. Bu hayvana binilmez, yünü kırkılmaz ve otlakta serbestçe yemesi engellenmez.

facets.statement: Damızlık geçmişi belirli bir ölçüye ulaşan erkek devenin sırtı kullanım dışı ve dokunulmaz sayılır.
Bu ölçü uzun süre damızlıkta kalma, torun dölletme ya da on batın döl verme biçiminde aktarılır.
Hayvana binilmez, yünü kırkılmaz ve otlakta yemesi engellenmez.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, damızlık geçmişi nedeniyle sırtı dokunulmaz sayılan erkek deve ve ona tanınan binilmeme, kırkılmama, otlaktan alıkonmama ayrıcalıklarında birleşir. Damızlık eşiği uzun süre, torun dölü ya da on batın ölçüsüyle farklı biçimlerde anlatılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hayvanın türünü, damızlık koşulunu ve kullanım dışı bırakılma sonucunu birlikte açıklar.

error_profile.preserves: Erkek deve, damızlık geçmişi ve dokunulmazlık öğelerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eski uygulamadaki hayvanı, en belirgin kullanım yasağı üzerinden kısa biçimde anlatır.

error_profile.loses: Yününün kırkılmaması, otlaktan alıkonmaması ve damızlık eşiğinin ayrıntılarını vermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dinî reddetme çekirdeği korunur; kalben bilip söylememe, bilip kabul etmeme, dıştan inanmış görünme ve hem kalple hem dille reddetme yapıya bağlı türlerdir.

concept_map.definition: İnancı, birliği, dinî hükmü veya peygamberliği reddederek dinî gerçeği örtmek ya da kabul etmemektir. Kaynaklar bunu inkâr, bile bile direnme, ikiyüzlülük, ortak koşma ve yalanlama gibi türlere ayırır.

facets.statement: İnancın karşıtı olarak dinî gerçeği, birliği, dinî hükmü veya peygamberliği reddetme.
Kalben bilip sözle kabul etmeme, bilip boyun eğmeme, dıştan inanmış görünme ve hem kalple hem dille inkâr etme farklı türlerdir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalı inancın karşıtı sayar ve gerçeği örtme düşüncesiyle açıklar; toplu aktarım çeşitli inkâr, direnme ve ikiyüzlülük biçimlerini de sıralar.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnancın karşıtı olan çekirdeği ve reddedilen dinî içeriği birlikte ifade eder.

error_profile.preserves: Dinî gerçeği kabul etmeme çekirdeğini ve inanç karşıtlığını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dalın genel dinî karşıtlık bağlamında eylem olarak çevrilmesi gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: İkiyüzlülük ve bütünüyle bilgisiz inkâr gibi öteki türleri dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi günahı veya bozulan yeminin doğurduğu yükü belirli bir karşılıkla örtme, silme ve işlenmemiş gibi kılma sürecini açıkça destekler.

lexicalization_scope.note: Günah yükünü giderme çekirdeği korunur; bozulmuş yemin için gerekeni yapma yalnızca ilgili söz öbeğine bağlı özel gerçekleşmedir.

concept_map.definition: Bir günahın ya da bozulan yeminin doğurduğu yükü, gereken karşılığı veya işlemi yerine getirerek örtmek, silmek ve işlenmemiş sayılacak duruma getirmektir.

facets.statement: Günahın yükünü örten veya silen karşılık ya da işlem.
Bozulan yemin için gereken yükümlülüğü yerine getirme, çekirdeğin yapıya bağlı özel türüdür.
İşlemin sonucu, kötülüğün işlenmemiş gibi değerlendirilmesi veya etkisinin silinmesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar günahın veya yeminin yükünü gideren karşılıkta birleşir; toplu anlatım hem gereken eylemi hem de günahın silinmiş sayılması sonucunu korur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem giderici işlemi hem de günahın etkisinin silinmesi sonucunu kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Günah yükünün bir karşılık veya işlemle ortadan kaldırılmasını korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi, özellikle deriyi, onarmak, dikmek veya bir eşya üretmek üzere kesip biçmektir; su tulumu hazırlama, bu işlemin yapım alanındaki özel bir uygulamasıdır.

Bu alanların bir bölümü yalan veya beklentinin boşa çıkması düşüncesiyle ilişkilendirilebilirken bir bölümü bağımsızlaşmış adlandırmalar olarak kalır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, çokluğu azlığın karşıtı ve sayının artması olarak kurar; ayrıca bir şeyin çok duruma gelmesini, çok duruma getirilmesini ve ondan çokça edinilmesini de açıkça kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın çokluk çekirdeğini öne alır; artırma, çokça edinme ve azıyla çoğunu birlikte anan kalıp ayrı bağımlı kullanımlar olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin ya da ayrık bir niceliğin az olmayacak ölçüde bulunması veya sayıca artmasıdır. Buna bir şeyi çok duruma getirme ve ondan çokça edinme gibi bu çekirdekten türeyen işlemler de bağlanır.

facets.statement: Çokluk, azlığın karşıtıdır ve özellikle sayılabilen varlıklarda sayının yüksekliğini ya da artışını bildirir.
Bir şey çok duruma gelebilir, bir başkası onu çok duruma getirebilir veya kişi ondan çokça edinebilir.
Az ve çok, malın ya da içinde bulunulan durumun iki karşıt ölçüsünü birlikte anan kalıpta kullanılabilir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه مكثر أو كاثر بمعنى كثير المال، ومكثار في كثرة الكلام، ومكثور عليه لكثرة طالبي المعروف أو الحقوق عليه، ويتكثر بمال غيره.
يدخل فيه الكوثر بوصفه نهر الجنة، أو الخير الكثير العظيم، أو الرجل السيد السخي الكثير الخير والعطاء، وكل ذلك من فوعل الكثرة.
يدخل فيه الكوثر من الغبار إذا كثر وثار أو سطع، وتكوثر الشيء إذا كثر كثرة متناهية.
يدخل فيه الكثر أو الكثر بمعنى جمار النخل، والجذب، وطلع النخل عند بعض المصادر، وما ورد في لا قطع في ثمر ولا كثر.
يدخل فيه الكمثرة بمعنى اجتماع الشيء، مع تصريح Maqāyīs بأن الميم زائدة وأنه من الكثرة.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin odağı devenin ön ayağını büküp bir bağla tutturmaktır. Kadının saçını tarayıp toplaması da aynı toplama ve tutma düzeninin bağımlı bir uzantısı olarak açıkça tanıklanır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, hayvan ayağını bağlayan temel kullanımla saçı toplayan söz öbeğine bağlı uzantıyı birbirine karıştırmadan gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Devenin ön ayağının alt bölümünü üst bölüme doğru büküp ip veya bağla tutturma işlemidir; bu işte kullanılan bağın kendisini de kapsar. Saçı tarayıp toplama, benzer tutma düzenine dayanan özel bir uzantıdır.

facets.statement: Devenin ön ayağını büküp bir bağla hareketini sınırlayacak biçimde tutturur.
Ayağı tutturmak için kullanılan ip veya bağın adını da içerir.
Kadının saçını tarayıp toplaması ve bağlaması için de kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar devenin ön ayağını bükerek bağlama işlemi ile kullanılan bağı ortak biçimde verir; saçı toplama kullanımını da aynı dala ekler.

concept_gloss.text: devenin ön ayağını büküp bağlayarak tutma
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın hayvan ayağına ilişkin temel işlemini ve bu işlemde kullanılan bağı en doğal biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Ön ayağı bükme, bağlama ve hareketini sınırlayarak tutma işlemlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnız kadının saçını düzenleyip bir arada tuttuğu uzantı bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Saçı tarama, toplama ve bir arada tutma işlemlerini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Devenin alt ön bacağını üst bölümüne doğru büküp özel bağla tutturur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Dirsek veya üst bacağı alt ekleme bağlayan ve hayvanı yavaşlatan bir bağlama biçimidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da devenin bir bacağını bağlayarak hareketini kısıtlar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal ön ayağın kendi bölümlerini büküp birbirine tutturur; komşu dal ise dirsek ya da üst bacağı daha aşağıdaki ekleme bağlayan başka bir düzenek belirtir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; bağın konumu ve uygulama biçimi bakımından en yakın olan deve bağlama dalı seçildi.

branches.source_phrase_ar: عقلت البعير أعقله عقلا إذا شددت يده بعقاله وهو الرباط (maqayis)؛ عقلت البعير عقلا شددت يده بالعقال أي الرباط (ayn)؛ عقلت البعير أعقله عقلا وهو أن تثني وظيفه مع ذراعه (sihah)؛ أصل العقل مصدر عقلت البعير بالعقال والعقال حبل (tahdhib)؛ كعقل البعير بالعقال (mufradat)؛ عقلت المرأة شعرها (sihah;tahdhib;mufradat)
